verdict.rationale: Column supports webhooks so external systems can be notified of events and react programmatically (column-docs-7), which is the closest primitive to event-driven automation. However, there is no evidence of a built-in rules engine or conditional-action system where users define 'if event X then action Y' logic natively within Column — automation still requires the customer to build reaction logic externally. Missing for 10: native rule/condition definition UI or API, built-in automated actions (e.g., auto-transfers, auto-holds) triggered by rules rather than external webhook consumers, and any documentation or community evidence of such a rules engine.
